item.tib: rig 'dzin brgyad cu'i zhu lan snyan rgyud zhal gdams bdud rtsi'i 'phreng ba gdams pa
item.coloph: kun bzang thugs kyi nying khu/ bder gshegs dgongs pa'i yang bcud/ rig 'dzin rnams kyi zab gter/ las can skyes bu'i dngos grub/ dad ldan rnams kyi byin rlabs/ mun pa gsal ba'i sgron me/ yar 'dzeg rnams kyi skas lam/ 'gro drug 'dren pa'i lcags kyu/ brgyad khri bzhi stong bon gyi yang snying / blo ldan dad pa can gyi skyes bu ngas/ 'gro drug sems can don du gong ma rnams la zhus/ yid ches dad mos byed cing yig yi ge ris su bkod/ byin rlabs 'jug phyir gong ma rnams la rab gnas zhus//
